sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加州的一处葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，且体内的血已被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手为了隐瞒她的身份，可谓煞费苦心。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 的全新系列，现已上线，各大播客平台均可收听。

sentences.en: On the 4th of March 2008, Julian Buckwald took his girlfriend Carolyn Watson for a picnic lunch to a waterfall located on a remote property in Budgery, Country Victoria.
sentences.zh: 2008年3月4日，朱利安·巴克沃德带着女友卡洛琳·沃森去维多利亚州乡村布杰里一处偏僻房产内的瀑布野餐。

sentences.en: The day soon turned into a nightmare when Julian and Carolyn were abducted by a masked attacker.
sentences.zh: 然而，当朱利安和卡洛琳被一名戴着面具的袭击者绑架时，这天很快变成了一场噩梦。

sentences.en: It wasn't long before Julian's mother located a frightening note from a satanic cult claiming responsibility for the abduction,
sentences.zh: 没过多久，朱利安的母亲便找到了一张令人毛骨悚然的纸条，一个撒旦邪教宣称对绑架事件负责，

sentences.en: and threatening to kill both Julian and Carolyn, both of whom were devout Christians.
sentences.zh: 并威胁要杀死朱利安和卡洛琳两人，他们俩都是虔诚的基督徒。

sentences.en: This sparked a frantic, widespread search.
sentences.zh: 这引发了一场疯狂而广泛的搜寻。

sentences.en: Would Julian and Carolyn be found alive?
sentences.zh: 朱利安和卡洛琳能被活着找到吗？

sentences.en: Was this really the work of a satanic cult?
sentences.zh: 这真的是撒旦邪教所为吗？

sentences.en: Or was there something even more sinister going on?
sentences.zh: 还是说背后有什么更阴险的事情在发生？

sentences.en: Julian Buckwald was 22 years old.
sentences.zh: 朱利安·巴克沃德年仅22岁。

sentences.en: He was from Budgery, a small country town in the Latrobe Valley in Victoria.
sentences.zh: 他来自维多利亚州拉特罗布谷的小乡村小镇布杰里。

sentences.en: About 160 kilometres, which is about 100 miles south-east of Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 距离墨尔本东南部大约160公里，也就是大约100英里。

sentences.en: Carolyn Watson was 17 years old.
sentences.zh: 卡洛琳·沃森17岁。

sentences.en: She lived nearby to Julian in the town of Churchill, also in the Latrobe Valley of Victoria.
sentences.zh: 她住在朱利安附近的丘吉尔镇，同样位于维多利亚州的拉特罗布谷。

sentences.en: They were both small country towns, and both Julian and Carolyn still lived with their parents.
sentences.zh: 这两个都是乡村小镇，朱利安和卡洛琳都还和父母住在一起。

sentences.en: On the 4th of March 2008, Julian and Carolyn had organised to go on a picnic at Julian's parents' property in Budgery.
sentences.zh: 2008年3月4日，朱利安和卡洛琳计划去朱利安父母位于布杰里的房产野餐。

sentences.en: The property was a rural, remote area, mostly bushland.
sentences.zh: 该房产是一片偏远的乡村区域，大部分是灌木林。

sentences.en: It covered an area of about 500 hectares, which is about 5 kilometres squared, or around 2 miles squared.
sentences.zh: 占地面积约500公顷，大约是5平方公里，或者大约2平方英里。

sentences.en: So it's a pretty large area.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一片相当大的区域。

sentences.en: Julian and Carolyn planned to visit a waterfall that was on the property to have their lunch together.
sentences.zh: 朱利安和卡洛琳计划去房产内的一个瀑布参观，并在那里一起吃午餐。

sentences.en: Julian picked Carolyn up in the morning in his 99 gold-coloured four-wheel drive Nissan Patrol, and they left for the waterfall.
sentences.zh: 朱利安早上开着他那辆99年产的金色日产巡洋舰四轮驱动汽车去接卡洛琳，然后他们出发去了瀑布。

sentences.en: They planned to be back around 3pm that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 他们计划在当天下午3点左右返回。

sentences.en: They took only basic clothing, and only the food and drink they needed for lunch.
sentences.zh: 他们只带了便服，以及午餐所需的食物和饮料。

sentences.en: Before they arrived at the waterfall, Julian stopped the car to check out the carcass of a dead animal he had seen.
sentences.zh: 在到达瀑布之前，朱利安把车停下，去查看他看到的一具动物尸体。

sentences.en: So he stops the car and tells Carolyn he will be back in a few minutes.
sentences.zh: 于是他停下车，告诉卡洛琳他几分钟后回来。

sentences.en: He'd stopped the car a little up the road from the carcass, so he had to walk back a short distance, and he was out of sight from Carolyn.
sentences.zh: 他把车停在离尸体不远的前方路段，所以他得步行一小段路回去，并且超出了卡洛琳的视线。

sentences.en: As he kneels down to check out the carcass, the nightmare begins.
sentences.zh: 当他跪下来查看尸体时，噩梦开始了。

sentences.en: He hears footsteps running up behind him, and he feels a hard blow to the back of his head, and he goes out cold, knocked unconscious.
sentences.zh: 他听到身后有跑步的脚步声，接着后脑勺遭到重重一击，随后他便失去了知觉，被打晕了过去。

sentences.en: While this is happening, Carolyn remains waiting in the car.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，卡洛琳留在车里等待。

sentences.en: After about 5-10 minutes, she starts getting a little concerned.
sentences.zh: 大约过了5到10分钟，她开始有点担心了。

sentences.en: It wasn't unusual for Julian to stop the car and get out to look at various things, dead animals included, but he usually was pretty quick about it.
sentences.zh: 朱利安停车下来看各种东西（包括死动物）并不罕见，但他通常动作挺快的。

sentences.en: He didn't usually take this long.
sentences.zh: 他平时不会花这么长时间。

sentences.en: Carolyn starts to think about getting out of the car to go and look for Julian when a person catches her eye in the side mirror.
sentences.zh: 正当卡洛琳考虑下车去找朱利安时，她在侧视镜里瞥见了一个人。

sentences.en: A person dressed in black, wearing gloves, and a balaclava is charging towards the car.
sentences.zh: 一个身穿黑衣、戴着手套和巴拉克拉瓦头套的人正朝车子冲过来。

sentences.en: Carolyn screams, but before she can think about locking herself in the car, the attacker has the door open and drags her out.
sentences.zh: 卡洛琳尖叫起来，但还没等她想起把车门反锁，袭击者就已经拉开车门把她拽了出去。

sentences.en: Carolyn gets thrown to the ground hard.
sentences.zh: 卡洛琳被重重地摔在地上。

sentences.en: The attacker doesn't waste any time.
sentences.zh: 袭击者没有浪费任何时间。

sentences.en: He immediately hogties her and covers her mouth with duct tape.
sentences.zh: 他立即把她五花大绑，并用强力胶带封住了她的嘴。

sentences.en: He then picks her up and throws her into the back seat of the car.
sentences.zh: 随后他抱起她，把她扔进汽车后座。

sentences.en: A little while later, the attacker gets into the driver's seat and starts driving away.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，袭击者坐上驾驶座，开车驶离。

sentences.en: Carolyn was beyond terrified.
sentences.zh: 卡洛琳吓得魂飞魄散。

sentences.en: She assumes the worst, thinking she's about to be raped and murdered.
sentences.zh: 她做好了最坏的打算，以为自己马上就要被强奸并杀害了。

sentences.en: After several hours of driving, the attacker eventually stops.
sentences.zh: 经过几个小时的车程，袭击者终于停了下来。

sentences.en: Carolyn was dragged out of the car and thrown to the ground.
sentences.zh: 卡洛琳被从车里拖出来，扔在地上。

sentences.en: Her mouth was still duct tape shut, so she couldn't scream.
sentences.zh: 她的嘴仍然被强力胶带封着，所以她无法尖叫。

sentences.en: She was still hogtired, so she couldn't move.
sentences.zh: 她依然被五花大绑，所以动弹不得。

sentences.en: And then she heard the sound that made her certain her life was about to end.
sentences.zh: 接着，她听到了一种让她确信自己生命即将走到尽头的声音。

sentences.en: Julian and Carolyn obviously didn't arrive home at 3pm.
sentences.zh: 朱利安和卡洛琳显然没有在下午3点回家。

sentences.en: It was out of character for them to be late.
sentences.zh: 迟到不符合他们的性格。

sentences.en: Julian's mother starts to worry and starts pacing around, walking up the driveway to see if there's any sign of them coming up the road.
sentences.zh: 朱利安的母亲开始担心起来，开始踱步，走到车道上张望路上有没有他们回来的迹象。

sentences.en: And that's when she sees it.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，她看到了那个东西。

sentences.en: A bottle stuck through their wire fence, with a piece of paper hanging out.
sentences.zh: 一个卡在铁丝网上的瓶子，上面挂着一张纸条。

sentences.en: Julian's mother quickly opened up the piece of paper, and she nearly fainted.
sentences.zh: 朱利安的母亲急忙打开纸条，差点昏厥过去。

sentences.en: The piece of paper read, and there's a language warning here.
sentences.zh: 纸条上写着以下内容，前方语言粗俗警告。

sentences.en: You bloody couldn't leave us alone, so your son and girl went walkabout.
sentences.zh: 你们他妈的别来烦我们，所以你儿子和女孩出去鬼混了。

sentences.en: You get Carolyn and Julian back when we finish our business in the area, but only if you behave yourself and don't shit us around again.
sentences.zh: 等我们办完这片区域的事，你就能把卡洛琳和朱利安接回去，但前提是你们老实点，别再跟我们耍花招。

sentences.en: Tell everyone they are on holiday.
sentences.zh: 告诉所有人他们在度假。

sentences.en: Don't you dare talk to the cops again, and you'll get your kids back.
sentences.zh: 你们敢再报警试试，就能把你们的孩子接回去。

sentences.en: Shit us again, and you never see them again.
sentences.zh: 再敢耍我们一次，你们就永远也别想见到他们了。

sentences.en: Because we'll fuck the girl to death and burn her alive, and the bloody boy will really enjoy the torture and sacrifice to our God to pay back 180 times the hurts he did to us
sentences.zh: 因为我们会把这女孩奸杀并活活烧死，而且那小子绝对会好好享受作为我们神的祭品的折磨，以此加倍奉还180倍他在我们抓住他们时对我们造成的伤害

sentences.en: when we picked them up.
sentences.zh: 当我们接走他们的时候。

sentences.en: This is your last warning.
sentences.zh: 这是你们最后一次警告。

sentences.en: Do what we say, and the kids come back in alive condition.
sentences.zh: 照我们说的做，孩子们就能活着回来。

sentences.en: Julian's mother is obviously terrified and distraught.
sentences.zh: 朱利安的母亲显然吓坏了，心烦意乱。

sentences.en: She immediately calls the police.
sentences.zh: 她立即报了警。

sentences.en: Threats don't get too more serious than this.
sentences.zh: 威胁再没有比这更严重的了。

sentences.en: The police were on high alert straight away.
sentences.zh: 警方立刻进入高度戒备状态。

sentences.en: They organised a large search operation by both land and by air.
sentences.zh: 他们组织了海陆空大规模搜救行动。

sentences.en: It wasn't an easy search.
sentences.zh: 这次搜救并不容易。

sentences.en: Not only was there a large area they had to cover, it was also very tricky terrain.
sentences.zh: 不仅搜寻面积巨大，地形也十分棘手。

sentences.en: It's remote bushland.
sentences.zh: 那是偏远的灌木林。

sentences.en: With a huge amount of dirt roads, hidden roads, side roads, and extensive off-road, thick bush area.
sentences.zh: 有着大量的泥土路、隐蔽的小路、支路，以及大片的越野茂密灌木区。

sentences.en: It was a hard search made harder by the fact the pressure was on.
sentences.zh: 这是一场艰难的搜寻，由于时间紧迫，难度更是雪上加霜。

sentences.en: It sounded like Carolyn and Julian were in the hands of complete psychopaths.
sentences.zh: 听起来卡洛琳和朱利安落入了一群彻头彻尾的精神病患者手中。

sentences.en: While the search was being conducted, detectives got to work trying to find out who was responsible and what their motive was.
sentences.zh: 在展开搜救的同时，侦探们开始着手查明幕后黑手是谁以及他们的动机是什么。

sentences.en: The note indicates there was some kind of prior history between the kidnappers and the Buckwold family.
sentences.zh: 字条表明绑架者和巴克沃德一家之间似乎存在某种过往的恩怨。

sentences.en: But not to the Buckwold's knowledge.
sentences.zh: 但巴克沃德一家却毫不知情。

sentences.en: They couldn't make any sense of the letter or the threats.
sentences.zh: 他们根本无法理解这封信或这些威胁。

sentences.en: They hadn't had trouble with anyone.
sentences.zh: 他们没有和任何人结怨。

sentences.en: But when interviewing Carolyn's parents, they were shocked to find out they had gotten a threatening letter from the same person about 10 days earlier.
sentences.zh: 但当走访卡洛琳的父母时，他们震惊地发现，大约10天前，卡洛琳的父母也收到过同一人发来的威胁信。

sentences.en: The letter said words to the effect of, mind your own business and stay away, or it will make your life a bloody misery and destroy you and your family.
sentences.zh: 信里大致意思是，少管闲事，离远点，否则会让你的人生苦不堪言，毁了你和你的家人。

sentences.en: It also says Christians are their enemies.
sentences.zh: 信中还说基督徒是他们的敌人。

sentences.en: Carolyn's father found it left on their front porch one morning and reported it to local police.
sentences.zh: 卡洛琳的父亲有一天早晨发现这封信被放在他们家的前廊上，并向当地警方报了案。

sentences.en: However, nothing was done.
sentences.zh: 然而，警方什么也没做。

sentences.en: It was chalked up to be a sick prank at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时这被归咎为恶劣的恶作剧。

sentences.en: Carolyn's father immediately recognised it was from the same person, as it had the same writing and also the same symbol that was on the letter found at the Buckwold's.
sentences.zh: 卡洛琳的父亲一眼就认出这出自同一人之手，因为笔迹一样，而且上面还有在巴克沃德家发现的信件上出现过的同一种符号。

sentences.en: The symbol on both letters gave them a hint as to why Christians were their enemies.
sentences.zh: 两封信上的符号暗示了为什么基督徒是他们的敌人。

sentences.en: It was a satanic symbol.
sentences.zh: 那是一个撒旦符号。

sentences.en: It was the symbol of the ONA, the Order of Nine Angles.
sentences.zh: 那是九角教（Order of Nine Angles，简称 ONA）的符号。

sentences.en: A satanic cult known to preach human sacrifice.
sentences.zh: 一个以宣扬活人献祭而闻名的撒旦邪教。

sentences.en: The letters were very concerning for police and gave them grave fears for Carolyn and Julian's safety.
sentences.zh: 这些信件让警方极为担忧，并对卡洛琳和朱利安的安全感到极度恐惧。

sentences.en: They were both devout Christians, which is why they felt they were targeted by a satanic cult.
sentences.zh: 他们都是虔诚的基督徒，这也是他们觉得自己被撒旦邪教盯上的原因。

sentences.en: Police feared they would make good on their threats and conduct a human sacrifice on them.
sentences.zh: 警方担心他们会兑现威胁，对他们进行活人献祭。

sentences.en: After 48 hours of extensive searching, there was still no trace of Julian or Carolyn.
sentences.zh: 经过48小时的大规模搜寻，仍然没有朱利安或卡洛琳的踪迹。

sentences.en: News quickly spread of their disappearance through the local community and their church pastor held constant prayer vigils for their safe return.
sentences.zh: 他们失踪的消息迅速在当地社区传开，他们的教堂牧师不断举行祈祷守夜活动，祈求他们平安归来。

sentences.en: Police interviewed the pastor to get his take on the satanic cult angle.
sentences.zh: 警方走访了牧师，听取他对撒旦邪教这一角度的看法。

sentences.en: They felt he might be able to provide some valuable information.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得他或许能提供一些有价值的信息。

sentences.en: What he had to say surprised police.
sentences.zh: 他所说的话让警方感到意外。

sentences.en: They thought he would be the first to believe in the satanic cult being responsible, but he wasn't.
sentences.zh: 他们本以为他会是第一个相信是撒旦邪教所为的人，但他并没有。

sentences.en: He didn't even believe they were kidnapped.
sentences.zh: 他甚至不相信他们是被绑架的。

sentences.en: He believed they had just run away together.
sentences.zh: 他认为他们只是私奔了。

sentences.en: Through their questioning of the pastor, they learnt that Julian and Carolyn were strict believers in their faith,
sentences.zh: 通过对牧师的盘问，他们得知朱利安和卡洛琳对信仰极其笃信，

sentences.en: and for that reason, the physical side of their relationship had not gotten past holding hands.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，他们恋爱的亲密程度甚至没有超越牵手。

sentences.en: He had recently had a meeting with a couple and learnt that they had planned to get married, but couldn't just yet because of Carolyn's age.
sentences.zh: 他最近曾与两人会面，得知他们计划结婚，但由于卡洛琳年龄的原因目前还结不成。

sentences.en: The pastor believed that's what they had done.
sentences.zh: 牧师相信这就是他们做过的事。

sentences.en: Run away together to get married.
sentences.zh: 私奔结婚去了。

sentences.en: Although he couldn't explain the two notes that were found, the language and vile nature of the notes was far removed from anything Julian and Carolyn would do.
sentences.zh: 尽管他无法解释找到的那两张字条，但字条中的语言和恶劣性质与朱利安和卡洛琳会做的事相去甚远。

sentences.en: Police started to investigate the possibility that Julian and Carolyn had run away together, but they didn't get very far with it.
sentences.zh: 警方开始调查朱利安和卡洛琳私奔的可能性，但调查并没有取得多大进展。

sentences.en: Remember, Julian and Carolyn didn't take any clothes or supplies with them, and they only had the food they had packed for their lunch.
sentences.zh: 记住，朱利安和卡洛琳没有带任何衣服或补给，他们身上只有为午餐打包的食物。

sentences.en: Also, their bank accounts hadn't been touched.
sentences.zh: 而且，他们的银行账户也没有被动过。

sentences.en: The running away together theory didn't really hold water, especially when you add in the threatening letters that had been received.
sentences.zh: 私奔的理论根本站不住脚，特别是考虑到收到的那些威胁信时更是如此。

sentences.en: Police were of the firm belief that Julian and Carolyn had been the victims of foul play.
sentences.zh: 警方坚信朱利安和卡洛琳成了谋杀或其他刑事犯罪的受害者。

sentences.en: They focused their investigation into the Order of Nine Angles cult.
sentences.zh: 他们将调查重点集中在九角教上。

sentences.en: They found the satanic cult was started in England in the 1960s.
sentences.zh: 他们发现这个撒旦邪教于20世纪60年代在英国创立。

sentences.en: They had affiliates around the world.
sentences.zh: 他们在世界各地都有分支机构。

sentences.en: The cult advocated a spiritual path in which practitioners were required to isolate themselves from society, commit crimes, embrace political extremism and violence,
sentences.zh: 该邪教倡导一种精神修行之路，要求修行者将自己与社会隔绝、犯罪、信奉政治极端主义和暴力，

sentences.en: and carry out a human sacrifice.
sentences.zh: 并进行活人献祭。

sentences.en: The problem the police ran into was that they couldn't find any evidence of the cult existing in Australia.
sentences.zh: 警方遇到的问题是，他们找不到该邪教在澳大利亚存在的任何证据。

sentences.en: They had no reports of anyone being a member of the cult.
sentences.zh: 他们没有接到任何人是该邪教成员的报告。

sentences.en: There were no previous cases on record involving the cult.
sentences.zh: 没有与该邪教相关的过往案件记录。

sentences.en: There weren't even any rumours or speculation of the cult existing anywhere in the country.
sentences.zh: 甚至没有任何关于该邪教在全国任何地方存在的传言或猜测。

sentences.en: This was baffling and there were fears that an Australian chapter had just formed and they wanted to start off with a bank, by conducting a human sacrifice.
sentences.zh: 这令人费解，人们担心澳大利亚刚刚成立了一个分部，而他们想通过进行活人献祭来一炮打响。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile 稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持 Casefile 继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Almost a week went by and there was still no trace of Julian or Carolyn.
sentences.zh: 将近一周过去了，依然没有朱利安或卡洛琳的踪迹。

sentences.en: The searches had come up empty.
sentences.zh: 搜寻工作一无所获。

sentences.en: There was no sign of them anywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都没有他们的踪影。

sentences.en: The feeling was that the chances of finding them alive went near slim to none.
sentences.zh: 大家感觉找到他们生还的几率微乎其微。

sentences.en: Police switched the focus of the search to finding remains, rather than finding them alive.
sentences.zh: 警方将搜寻重点从寻找活人转移到了寻找遗体上。

sentences.en: The rugged bushland had extremely hot temperatures in the day, but became freezing cold at night.
sentences.zh: 崎岖的灌木林白天温度极高，但到了晚上却冷得冰冻三尺。

sentences.en: There were snakes and spiders everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是蛇和蜘蛛。

sentences.en: Not easy conditions at the best of times, but when you consider Julian and Carolyn had no food or supplies and minimal clothing, the conditions became that much worse.
sentences.zh: 在平时这都不是轻松的环境，而考虑到朱利安和卡洛琳没有食物和补给、衣着单薄，环境就变得更加恶劣了。

sentences.en: The remote area meant there were no witnesses, so there was no information coming in from the public at all to help the investigation.
sentences.zh: 偏远的地区意味着没有目击者，因此完全没有公众提供的线索来协助调查。

sentences.en: The only major police could establish at this stage was the Order of Nine Angles cult wanting to commit a human sacrifice.
sentences.zh: 警方在这个阶段唯一能确定的重大线索是九角教想要进行活人献祭。

sentences.en: But given there was no information to suggest the cult even existed in Australia, police started to explore the possibility that the Nates were left as a diversion,
sentences.zh: 但鉴于没有任何信息表明该邪教在澳大利亚存在，警方开始探讨这些字条可能是作为一种转移视线的手段留下的可能性，

sentences.en: to throw them off the trail of the real abductors.
sentences.zh: 目的是把他们从真正的绑架者身上引开。

sentences.en: But seven days after their disappearance, when all hope seemed lost, and police thought they were looking for bodies, the miracle happened.
sentences.zh: 但在他们失踪七天后，当所有希望似乎都破灭、警方以为自己在寻找尸体时，奇迹发生了。

sentences.en: Julian and Carolyn were found alive.
sentences.zh: 朱利安和卡洛琳被活着找到了。

sentences.en: They stumbled out onto the road near the Alpine National Park, hundreds of kilometres away from their picnic destination.
sentences.zh: 他们踉踉跄跄地走出来，到了距离野餐目的地数百公里外的高山国家公园附近的路面上。

sentences.en: They were picked up by a farmer who was driving along the road.
sentences.zh: 他们被一名开车路过的农民接上了车。

sentences.en: They would have stood out.
sentences.zh: 他们当时肯定很显眼。

sentences.en: Both were in pretty bad shape.
sentences.zh: 两人的状态都很糟糕。

sentences.en: They had cuts and bruises and both suffered from bad sunburn.
sentences.zh: 他们身上有割伤和淤青，两人的严重晒伤都很厉害。

sentences.en: Their bodies were covered in blisters.
sentences.zh: 他们的身体上布满了水泡。

sentences.en: Detectives wasted no time.
sentences.zh: 侦探们没有浪费任何时间。

sentences.en: They interviewed them straight away.
sentences.zh: 他们立刻对两人进行了盘问。

sentences.en: They needed as much information as possible.
sentences.zh: 他们需要尽可能多的信息。

sentences.en: The attackers were still out there.
sentences.zh: 袭击者仍然在逃。

sentences.en: They thought it very possible other family members of Carolyn or Julian could be at risk.
sentences.zh: 他们认为卡罗琳或朱利安的其他家庭成员极有可能处于危险之中。

sentences.en: Carolyn is interviewed and details are attacked to police.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳接受了问讯，细节被通报给警方。

sentences.en: The attacker dug the hole only a few metres away from her.
sentences.zh: 袭击者挖的洞距离她只有几米远。

sentences.en: The attacker then made his way towards Carolyn.
sentences.zh: 随后，袭击者朝卡罗琳走去。

sentences.en: He cut her clothing off with a knife, leaving her completely naked and still tied up.
sentences.zh: 他用刀割破了她的衣服，使她赤身裸体且依然被绑着。

sentences.en: She was convinced she was about to be raped, murdered and then buried in the hole.
sentences.zh: 她确信自己马上要被强奸、谋杀，然后埋进那个坑里。

sentences.en: Carolyn does about the only thing she can do.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳做了她唯一能做的事。

sentences.en: She starts to pray.
sentences.zh: 她开始祈祷。

sentences.en: She prays and prays and prays.
sentences.zh: 她不停地祈祷、祈祷、再祈祷。

sentences.en: And almost as if God himself had shown up to save her, the attacker disappears.
sentences.zh: 几乎就像上帝亲临来拯救她一样，袭击者消失了。

sentences.en: She has no idea where he went or what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 她根本不知道他去了哪里，也不知道他在干什么。

sentences.en: But she seemed to be spared for the time being.
sentences.zh: 但她暂时似乎逃过了一劫。

sentences.en: But she was still tied up and couldn't move.
sentences.zh: 不过她仍然被绑着，动弹不得。

sentences.en: Sometime later she hears a familiar voice.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，她听到一个熟悉的声音。

sentences.en: Julian's voice.
sentences.zh: 朱利安的声音。

sentences.en: She cries out,
sentences.zh: 她大喊道：

sentences.en: Julian, is that you?
sentences.zh: 朱利安，是你吗？

sentences.en: He screams back, yes.
sentences.zh: 他大声回应说，是的。

sentences.en: Julian is also tied up and naked.
sentences.zh: 朱利安也同样被绑着，一丝不挂。

sentences.en: And had just woken up after being knocked out.
sentences.zh: 而且他刚刚在被打晕后醒来。

sentences.en: He wiggles his way through the scrub, over to Carolyn.
sentences.zh: 他在灌木丛中蠕动着挪到了卡罗琳身边。

sentences.en: He sees a knife laying on the ground next to her, obviously left there by the attacker.
sentences.zh: 他看到地上躺着一把刀，就在她旁边，显然是袭击者留下的。

sentences.en: He grabs the knife and with Carolyn's help, they were able to cut the rope.
sentences.zh: 他抓起刀，在卡罗琳的帮助下，他们割断了绳子。

sentences.en: They stand up and see the attacker had left behind a sleeping bag and a few items of food.
sentences.zh: 他们站起身，发现袭击者留下了一个睡袋和一些食物。

sentences.en: They were both terrified.
sentences.zh: 两人都吓坏了。

sentences.en: They had no idea where he was, but they could only assume he was coming back at some stage.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道他在哪里，但只能假设他随时会回来。

sentences.en: So they grabbed the sleeping bag and the bits of food and ran off.
sentences.zh: 于是他们抓起睡袋和零星的食物跑了。

sentences.en: They were barefoot, naked, battling the extreme heat during the day and the freezing cold at night.
sentences.zh: 他们光着脚，赤身裸体，白天与极端的高温搏斗，夜晚则忍受严寒。

sentences.en: They both had cut feet and cuts on their body from the bush.
sentences.zh: 他们的脚和身体都被灌木丛划破了。

sentences.en: They were both badly sunburned.
sentences.zh: 两人都严重晒伤。

sentences.en: And they both wondered if their lives were about to end.
sentences.zh: 他们都在想，自己的生命是不是就要走到尽头了。

sentences.en: If the attacker tracked them down.
sentences.zh: 如果袭击者追踪到他们的话。

sentences.en: It was a horrific experience.
sentences.zh: 这是一次恐怖的经历。

sentences.en: During their ordeal they got a bit disorientated and ended up back near the site that they had escaped from.
sentences.zh: 在他们的磨难中，他们有些迷失方向，最终回到了他们逃跑的那个地点附近。

sentences.en: This was bad, as it meant the attacker was probably nearby, but they got lucky.
sentences.zh: 这很糟糕，因为这意味着袭击者可能就在附近，但他们走运了。

sentences.en: While they were checking out the site, Julian spots the backpack that they had taken with them the day of the picnic.
sentences.zh: 当他们查看现场时，朱利安发现了他们野餐那天随身携带的背包。

sentences.en: He runs over and gets it, and they are in luck.
sentences.zh: 他跑过去拿到了背包，他们真走运。

sentences.en: Their clothing is inside.
sentences.zh: 里面装着他们的衣服。

sentences.en: Julian runs back to Carolyn with the backpack, and they are able to clothe themselves.
sentences.zh: 朱利安拿着背包跑回卡罗琳身边，他们终于能穿上衣服了。

sentences.en: They stumble around the bush for another few days before lucking out and finding the road where they were picked up by the farmer.
sentences.zh: 他们在灌木丛中跌跌撞撞地走了好几天，最后运气好找到了那条公路，并在那里被一位农民搭救。

sentences.en: Luckily, the attacker never caught up with them again.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，袭击者再也没有追上他们。

sentences.en: It was important that police identify the site where they escaped from.
sentences.zh: 对警方来说，确认他们逃跑的地点非常重要。

sentences.en: There would be a lot of evidence there, which could help them track down whoever was responsible.
sentences.zh: 那里会有大量证据，可以帮助他们追踪幕后黑手。

sentences.en: Police conducted an extensive search of the bush area around where Carolyn and Julian were found, and they got lucky.
sentences.zh: 警方对发现卡罗琳和朱利安的地点周围的灌木丛进行了地毯式搜查，他们运气不错。

sentences.en: They found the site.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了那个地点。

sentences.en: They found bits of rope and items of clothing.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了零星的绳索和几件衣物。

sentences.en: They also found the knife, the shovel, and the duct tape.
sentences.zh: 他们还找到了那把刀、铁锹和强力胶带。

sentences.en: They had a lot of evidence.
sentences.zh: 他们掌握了大量证据。

sentences.en: Not only that, they were able to identify the person that owned all of those iteMs.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他们还确认了所有这些物品的主人是谁。

sentences.en: It was great news, albeit somewhat confusing news, and it posed a lot more questions than answers, because the owner of those items was Julian.
sentences.zh: 这是个好消息，虽然也有些令人困惑，并且引发了更多的问题而不是答案，因为这些物品的主人正是朱利安。

sentences.en: Something didn't add up.
sentences.zh: 有些事情说不通。

sentences.en: As far as police could tell, the attacker didn't bring any of his own equipment to use.
sentences.zh: 据警方所知，袭击者并没有带任何自己的装备来作案。

sentences.en: He used all of Julian's stuff.
sentences.zh: 他用的全部都是朱利安的东西。

sentences.en: But how did he get it?
sentences.zh: 但他到底是怎么弄到这些的呢？

sentences.en: There was another problem.
sentences.zh: 还有一个问题。

sentences.en: Julian had described to police how he was whacked over the head by the attacker, knocking him unconscious.
sentences.zh: 朱利安曾向警方描述他是如何被袭击者狠狠砸了头部而失去知觉的。

sentences.en: Then he doesn't remember anything until he woke up naked, tied up in the bush.
sentences.zh: 然后他就什么都不记得了，直到自己赤身裸体、被绑在灌木丛中醒来。

sentences.en: But the mark on Julian's head from where he had been struck was hardly visible.
sentences.zh: 但朱利安头部受击的痕迹几乎看不出来。

sentences.en: It didn't really match up with his story being hit hard and knocked out.
sentences.zh: 这与他遭受重击并被打晕的说法实在不符。

sentences.en: Police start to wonder if Julian was somehow involved in his own kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 警方开始怀疑朱利安是否参与了自导自演的绑架。

sentences.en: Detectives let Julian know his story wasn't adding up.
sentences.zh: 侦探们直告朱利安，他的说法根本说不通。

sentences.en: They were up front with him.
sentences.zh: 他们对他说得很坦白。

sentences.en: They basically told him his story was full of shit.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上告诉他，他的供词一派胡言。

sentences.en: They told him to tell them the truth.
sentences.zh: 他们要求他说出实话。

sentences.en: And he eventually cracked.
sentences.zh: 他最终心理崩溃了。

sentences.en: The evidence exposed his lies.
sentences.zh: 证据戳穿了他的谎言。

sentences.en: He knew it was all over.
sentences.zh: 他知道一切都完了。

sentences.en: He made full admissions to police that he orchestrated the whole attack.
sentences.zh: 他向警方全盘招认，自己策划了整场袭击。

sentences.en: He was the sole person responsible for Caroline's kidnapping, faking his own kidnapping in the process.
sentences.zh: 他是卡罗琳被绑架的唯一幕后黑手，并在过程中伪造了自己的绑架。

sentences.en: Julian tells detectives everything.
sentences.zh: 朱利安向侦探们交代了一切。

sentences.en: He points out the spot where he stashed all of his supplies.
sentences.zh: 他指出了自己藏匿所有物资的地点。

sentences.en: He had pre-planned the attack.
sentences.zh: 他提前策划了这次袭击。

sentences.en: He had buried a map and the other supplies that he needed, such as the shovel, knife, rope and duct tape.
sentences.zh: 他埋下了一张地图以及其他需要的物资，比如铁锹、刀、绳索和强力胶带。

sentences.en: He lied about seeing the dead animal carcass.
sentences.zh: 他撒谎说看到了死去的动物尸体。

sentences.en: He used that time to change and disguise himself as a kidnapper.
sentences.zh: 他利用那个时间换衣服并把自己伪装成绑匪。

sentences.en: He tied Caroline up and then drove six hours north to the remote Alpine National Park area.
sentences.zh: 他绑了卡罗琳，然后开车向北行驶了六个小时，来到偏远的阿尔卑斯山国家公园地区。

sentences.en: So no wonder the police search failed.
sentences.zh: 难怪警察的搜查失败了。

sentences.en: They had no hope of finding them.
sentences.zh: 他们根本没有找到人的希望。

sentences.en: They weren't searching anywhere near there.
sentences.zh: 他们搜寻的地方和那里相去甚远。

sentences.en: Julian chillingly recounts how Caroline was begging him to stop, saying please don't do this, pleading for her life.
sentences.zh: 朱利安令人毛骨悚然地回忆起卡罗琳如何哀求他停手，说请不要这样，苦苦哀求他饶自己一命。

sentences.en: He describes how he cut off her clothes and dug the hole.
sentences.zh: 他描述了自己是如何割掉她的衣服并挖洞的。

sentences.en: He then details how he took his own clothes off and tied himself up, and how he started calling out to Caroline a while later, to make her look like he had been attacked as well.
sentences.zh: 接着他详细讲述了自己如何脱掉衣服并把自己绑起来，以及过了一会儿他是如何开始呼喊卡罗琳的，好让人觉得他也遭到了袭击。

sentences.en: So police had their man.
sentences.zh: 至此，警察抓住了真凶。

sentences.en: But why the hell would anybody want to kidnap their girlfriend and stage their own kidnapping?
sentences.zh: 但到底为什么有人会想要绑架自己的女友并自导自演一场绑架呢？

sentences.en: What reason could possibly exist for Julian to do that?
sentences.zh: 朱利安怎么可能会有这种动机？

sentences.en: The reason is, Julian staged the whole thing to try and have sex with Caroline, and to get her to marry him.
sentences.zh: 原因在于，朱利安策划这一切是为了和卡罗琳发生性关系，并逼她嫁给自己。

sentences.en: Throughout the entire ordeal, Julian was in Caroline's ear, saying that they had to have sex to keep warm at night.
sentences.zh: 在整个折磨过程中，朱利安一直在卡罗琳耳边唠叨，说他们必须发生性关系才能在夜里保暖。

sentences.en: And for that reason, it wouldn't be wrong in the eyes of God.
sentences.zh: 而且出于这个原因，在上帝眼中这并不是罪过。

sentences.en: But Caroline stuck strong to her faith, and refused Julian's advances for sex, and refused his marriage proposals.
sentences.zh: 但卡罗琳坚定自己的信仰，拒绝了朱利安的性要求，也拒绝了他的求婚。

sentences.en: They had planned to get married one day, but there was tension between them about the timing.
sentences.zh: 他们曾计划有一天结婚，但在时间安排上存在分歧。

sentences.en: Julian wanted to get married now, whereas Caroline wanted to wait until she finished her studies.
sentences.zh: 朱利安想马上结婚，而卡罗琳则想等完成学业再说。

sentences.en: Plus, she wasn't old enough.
sentences.zh: 况且，她当时还没到法定年龄。

sentences.en: At no stage was Julian ever loSt.
sentences.zh: 朱利安在任何阶段都没有迷路。

sentences.en: He knew exactly where they were the entire time.
sentences.zh: 他自始至终都清楚他们在哪儿。

sentences.en: He just pretended to be lost as an excuse to spend more time with Caroline, to try and get her to crack and have sex with him.
sentences.zh: 他只是假装迷路，以此为借口和卡罗琳多呆一会儿，试图让她崩溃并与他发生关系。

sentences.en: Julian thought he would only need a couple of days.
sentences.zh: 朱利安以为自己只需要几天时间。

sentences.en: He'd get Caroline to either have sex with him, or agree to get married, or both.
sentences.zh: 他会让卡罗琳要么跟他发生关系，要么同意结婚，或者两者兼顾。

sentences.en: And then they would leave the area.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就会离开这个地区。

sentences.en: But after a week, it became apparent Caroline was having none of it.
sentences.zh: 但一周后，很明显卡罗琳根本不吃这一套。

sentences.en: So he made his way out towards the road to be rescued.
sentences.zh: 于是他朝公路方向走去，等待救援。

sentences.en: Julian was charged with unlawfully carrying away against one's will, abduction with intent to marry, abduction for sexual penetration, and theft.
sentences.zh: 朱利安被指控违背他人意愿非法带离、以结婚为目的的绑架、以发生性行为为目的的绑架以及盗窃罪。

sentences.en: The court heard that as a result of being hogtied and left in the back of the vehicle for 60 hours,
sentences.zh: 法庭听取了陈述，由于被五花大绑并扔在车厢后部长达60个小时，

sentences.en: Caroline had severe damage to her neck, back, and hands.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳的颈部、背部和双手受到了严重损伤。

sentences.en: Julian was found guilty at court in 2009, but he wasn't remanded into custody straight away.
sentences.zh: 朱利安于2009年在法庭上被判有罪，但他并没有被立即收监。

sentences.en: He was allowed to stay out on bail while awaiting the sentencing hearing.
sentences.zh: 他在等待宣判听证会期间被允许保释在外。

sentences.en: But Julian didn't want to hang around for his sentencing date.
sentences.zh: 但朱利安并不想留下来等待宣判日期的到来。

sentences.en: He would have known he was going to get jail time for what he did.
sentences.zh: 他很清楚自己所做的事会让他入狱服刑。

sentences.en: So he tried to pull off an escape.
sentences.zh: 于是他试图策划一场逃跑。

sentences.en: He got hold of a fake Indian passport.
sentences.zh: 他弄到了一本假的印度护照。

sentences.en: He dyed his hair and darkened his skin in an attempt to look Indian.
sentences.zh: 他染了头发，把皮肤晒黑，试图让自己看起来像印度人。

sentences.en: It was a ridiculous disguise.
sentences.zh: 这是一个荒谬的伪装。

sentences.en: But he somehow managed to pull Australian customs because he got out of the country.
sentences.zh: 但他不知怎么竟然糊弄过了澳大利亚海关，成功逃出了国境。

sentences.en: Thankfully, he didn't get very far.
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地，他没跑多远。

sentences.en: He was detained when he landed, his real identity was discovered, and he was extradited back to Australia.
sentences.zh: 他一落地就被扣留，真实身份被发现，随后被引渡回澳大利亚。

sentences.en: His plan was to eventually make his way to Germany, where he had relatives.
sentences.zh: 他的计划是最终前往德国，他在那里有亲戚。

sentences.en: He was later sentenced to seven years and three months for kidnapping Caroline, and he was sentenced to a further six months for skipping bail and leaving the country.
sentences.zh: 他后来因绑架卡罗琳被判处七年零三个月监禁，又因违反保释规定潜逃出境被加判六个月。

sentences.en: He had a non-parole period of five years and three months,
sentences.zh: 他的不得假释期为五年零三个月，

sentences.en: meaning he is eligible for release now.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他现在已经符合假释条件。

sentences.en: And if he isn't out already,
sentences.zh: 如果他现在还没被释放，

sentences.en: it won't be long until he is.
sentences.zh: 那也用不了多久了。

sentences.en: And I was not calling for full silence.
sentences.zh: 我并不是在呼吁保持绝对安静。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。
